newsitem.title: JAPAN: Olympic Sports ask-only at midday.
newsitem.headline: Olympic Sports ask-only at midday.

text.p: Shares in Olympic Sports Co were ask-only at midday on Wednesday, after the Japan Securities Dealers Association (JSDA) said on Friday that it had cancelled the firm's registration on the over-the-counter (OTC) market.
At midday, the shares were ask-only at 351 yen, with 1.02 million shares offered for sale. The shares were last traded on Thursday at 471 yen.
The JSDA's move followed Olympic Sports' application for court mediation with creditors.

The sports equipment retailer has said that it has debts totalling 34.83 billion yen, and applied for court mediation after it was refused loans by financial institutions for bills to be cleared on September 20.
